تلاعبت (form VI)
# تَلَاعَبْتُ (talāʕabtu) /ta.laː.ʕab.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَلَاعَبَ (talāʕaba)
# تَلَاعَبْتَ (talāʕabta) /ta.laː.ʕab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَلَاعَبَ (talāʕaba)
# تَلَاعَبْتِ (talāʕabti) /ta.laː.ʕab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَلَاعَبَ (talāʕaba)
# تَلَاعَبَتْ (talāʕabat) /ta.laː.ʕa.bat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
